tool_args.rationale: At the target horizon, the source-range hydraulic baseline misses the six rows by at least 0.094 training RMSE. Stronger smooth suppression fits within tolerance, but the pilot varies input and gradient together, so that fit does not resolve the branch ambiguity. Acquire the finer batch before committing to either mechanism.

considered_alternatives.option: Smooth hydraulic saturation with free gradient suppression
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It fits the six rows at about 0.024 training RMSE, but requires rho near 0.82 instead of the source range of 0.69–0.72. The current rows do not show whether this shift generalizes or absorbs a localized branch.

considered_alternatives.option: Hydraulic saturation with a conjunctive branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The added observation samples one candidate open-branch condition; it does not locate the transition or constrain its width.
It does not distinguish gradient suppression from branch activation.
